prompt:
Independently audit this contract against the indexed spec only.
Check (1) every spec segment mapped to a rule or marked unrelated/missing, (2) absent verbatim
evidence without uncertain, (3) contradictions between rule fields and examples, (4) plausible
alternative semantics with a concrete distinguishing chronological input sequence, and (5) derive
outputs for any explicit spec waveform/table/examples and compare. Report distinct material issues.
Return JSON {coverage:{Sxx:[rule IDs or "unrelated"/"missing"]},issues:[
{issue_id,rule_id (or "global"),type:"coverage"|"grounding"|"consistency"|"ambiguity"|"spec_example",
severity:"high"|"medium"|"low",detail,spec_evidence (verbatim spec or ""),alternative,sequence}]}.
Keep any deliberation brief and use short issue descriptions so the entire JSON fits. For ambiguity
the alternative must be specific; sequence must be a nonempty list of complete
width-valid nonclock input rows (optional mid) using the contract ports. For other types alternative
can be an empty string and sequence can be []. Code and prose outside JSON are not needed.
Indexed specification:
{"S01":"Create 8 D flip-flops with active high synchronous reset setting the output to zero.","S02":"All DFFs should be triggered by the positive edge of clk."}
Contract JSON:
{"ports":{"inputs":{"d":8,"reset":1},"outputs":{"q":8},"clock":"clk"},"states":[{"name":"q","meaning":"8-bit registered output; holds its value except at posedge clk, where active-high synchronous reset clears it to 0 or otherwise captures d.","update_time":"posedge clk after inputs have settled","update_during_reset":true}],"rules":[{"id":"sync_reset_clears_q","outputs":["q"],"condition":"posedge clk and reset == 1; q becomes 0","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"active high synchronous reset setting the output to zero","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"d":42,"reset":1},{"d":87,"reset":0},{"d":200,"reset":1}],"expected":[{"q":0},{"q":87},{"q":0}]}},{"id":"load_d_on_posedge_when_not_reset","outputs":["q"],"condition":"posedge clk and reset == 0; q becomes d","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":2,"spec_quote":"Create 8 D flip-flops","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"d":0,"reset":1},{"d":170,"reset":0},{"d":85,"reset":0}],"expected":[{"q":0},{"q":170},{"q":85}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"sync","name":"reset","active":"high","values":{"q":0},"first_released_cycle":"first sampled posedge with reset == 0"},"mid":"mid holds post-sample changes to nonclock inputs; they are applied after the current sampled edge and carried to the start of the next row.","uncertain":[]}
